title: 第25章 夺药第26章 冲击后天之体二层
content_zh:
;;
亲眼见到这让人难以置信的一幕。
李向东心里可谓是又惊又喜。
喜的是来得早不如来的巧，居然正好赶上一枚七星连珠果即将成熟。
惊的是这下难搞了！
这么大的动静绝对会把那恐怖的玩意儿引出来。
让偷都成为一种奢望！
面对着土堆下方突然冒出的大洞，李向东心中陷入了沉思。
这个洞如果不是那条斑斓大蛇的窝，十有八九就是那东西的！
有道是知己知彼，百战百胜，现在连对手是个什么东西都不清楚。
再贸然行动只怕会招来横祸！
李向东正要开启麒麟神瞳往洞中张望。
然而就在这时。
身后忽然传来破土而出的异动，紧接着就是一阵毛骨悚然的感觉上身！
“不好！”
“在后面！”
李向东察觉到身后的变故，想也不想，就地往旁边一个翻滚！
砰！
两道巨大的轰击声砸得泥土飞溅！
李向东躲开后惊恐回望，迅速看清楚袭击的东西是何物。

不是意料中的大蛇！
而是一条有着三米多长庞大身躯，浑身黑到发亮。
头上挥舞着两条血红钢鞭似的触须，背壳上长出坚硬尖刺。
身下还有上百只和锯齿一样锋利勾脚的恐怖大蜈蚣。
它一番精心准备的绕后没杀死李向东，气得暴怒连连。
张开恐怖的巨口发出嘶吼。
吼完后上百只脚整齐挪动，飞速又往李向东这边爬了过来！
李向东不知对方深浅，提着大刀急忙后退。
谁知那大蜈蚣爬行的速度也非常快，很快就欺近到身前，挥动头上两根血红的触须再次展开猛烈进攻！
李向东闪躲不及只能提起大刀抵挡。
砰砰砰砰！
锋利大刀与砸下来的红须相撞，居然诡异的发出金铁交加的声音。
“刀枪不入！”
面对这样的结果，李向东骇的面无人色。
心中快速放弃与它战斗的想法。
飞速运起长生经，将身体里的大部分的气都灌入双脚夺路狂奔。
只留小部分灌入麒麟神瞳打探它的底细！

Witnessing this incredible scene with your own eyes.
Li Xiangdong was both surprised and happy.
Fortunately, it was a coincidence that it came sooner than it came, and it happened to coincide with the ripening of a seven-star cassava fruit.
Surprisingly, it’s so difficult now!
Such a big movement will definitely draw out the scary thing.
Let stealing become a luxury!
Facing the big hole that suddenly appeared under the mound, Li Xiangdong fell into deep thought.
If this hole is not the nest of that big colorful snake, it is most likely that thing!
The right way is to know yourself and the enemy, and you will win every battle. Now you don't even know who your opponent is.
If you act rashly again, you may cause disaster!
Li Xiangdong was about to open his Qilin Divine Eyes and look into the cave.
But at this moment.
Suddenly there was a sudden movement behind him, followed by a creepy feeling on his body!
"Not good!"
"In the back!"
Li Xiangdong noticed what happened behind him, and rolled to the side without even thinking about it!
Bang!
Two huge bombardments caused the soil to fly!
Li Xiangdong dodged and looked back in horror, quickly seeing what the attack was.
Not the big snake I expected!
Instead, it was a huge body over three meters long, all black and shiny.
There were two blood-red steel whip-like tentacles waving on its head, and hard spikes sprouted from its back.
There are hundreds of terrifying giant centipedes under him with hooked legs as sharp as saw teeth.
It made a carefully prepared maneuver and failed to kill Li Xiangdong, so it became furious.
It opened its terrifying huge mouth and roared.
After roaring, hundreds of feet moved in order and quickly crawled towards Li Xiangdong!
Li Xiangdong didn't know the opponent's depth, so he hurriedly backed away with a broadsword in hand.
Unexpectedly, the big centipede crawled very fast, and soon it came close to him, waving the two blood-red tentacles on its head and launched another fierce attack!
Li Xiangdong couldn't dodge and could only raise his sword to block.
Bang bang bang bang!
The sharp sword collided with the smashed red beard, and it made a strange sound of gold and iron.
"Invulnerable!"
Faced with such a result, Li Xiangdong's face turned pale.
I quickly gave up on the idea of ​​fighting it.
He quickly picked up the Immortality Meridian, poured most of the energy in his body into his feet and ran wildly.
Leave only a small part and pour it into the Qilin Divine Eye to find out its details!
